title: Three bodies, one butterfly
question: How fast does a tiny difference in where the stars start grow until the future is unpredictable?
line: Three stars of 3, 4 and 5 suns start at rest on the corners of a 3-4-5 triangle measured in AU (Burrau's 'Pythagorean' problem), here lifted out of the flat plane: the stars start +1, +0.5 and −1 AU a
